purpose: Teach: 胴/天地/断層/母語/鉱業/私生活/積雪/雌

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の胴体CT撮影を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren — we handle patient torso CT scans as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady pace. Direct eye contact level. Conveying institutional capability without fanfare. Brief pause after the name.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、天地が逆さの転倒事故患者も医療チームで扱います
lines.en: Yes — and we handle trauma patients with inverted orientation from falls as part of our team approach.
lines.style: Even steadier now. Slightly slower. The kind of calm that comes from having seen this before. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive of the complexity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 断層撮影で見つかる病変を、貴院、診られますね、先生
lines.en: So the lesions you find on those tomography scans — your hospital can diagnose those directly, can't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Building toward something. Respectful deference with an undertone of genuine inquiry. Pause before the question.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、母語が違う患者の通訳サービスを医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes — we provide interpretation services for patients whose first language isn't Japanese as part of our team care.
lines.style: Same composed rhythm. Listing these capabilities not as boasts but as baseline standards. Measured breath. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 鉱業従事者の塵肺を、貴院、診療されてますね、先生
lines.en: And your hospital treats occupational pneumoconiosis in mining workers, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Same careful respect as before. Asking not to challenge but to understand the scope. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の私生活への配慮を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Yes — we prioritize attention to our patients' personal circumstances as a team discipline.
lines.style: Unwavering calm. These aren't extras — they're standards. Quiet conviction on "prioritize." No apology for thoroughness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、積雪期の救急搬送を医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Yes — we manage emergency transport during heavy snow season as part of our coordinated response.
lines.style: Same steady delivery. Practical, not dramatic about the difficulty. The tone of someone who plans for what others might overlook.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 雌性ホルモンの研究を、貴院、進められてますね、先生
lines.en: You're advancing research on estrogen, aren't you, Doctor — here at your hospital?
lines.style: Brightest yet — genuine interest now, not just testing. Close attention in the voice. The shift from institutional questions to scientific ones. Admiring.
